item.title: Ryugenbuchi: An Emerald River Pool Beneath Mount Fuji — Guide
item.description: Ryugenbuchi is a quiet, lightly visited beauty spot on the Shiba River near Fujinomiya, where the river gathers into deep pools of a striking emerald-green colour, fed by the clear waters flowing down from Mount Fuji. On clear days the mountain itself rises in the background, and in spring cherry blossoms line the banks, making it a rewarding stop for photographers seeking a Fuji view without crowds, though it remains a modest local spot rather than a developed attraction.
